section.content: 本实用新型涉及一种锂离子电池，所述锂离子电池包括锂离子电池本体与压力检测装置，所述压力检测装置包括PVDF压电薄膜传感器，所述PVDF压电薄膜传感器设置于所述锂离子电池本体表面，以检测锂离子电池表面的压力变化。通过在锂离子电池外壳贴合PVDF压电薄膜传感器的方式，可快速检测锂离子电池外部压力的变化，既方便又快捷，可有效防止安全事故的发生，且PVDF压电薄膜传感器，其反应灵敏，制作方便，使用成本较低。

The utility model relates to a lithium ion battery, lithium ion battery includes lithium ion battery body and pressure measurement, pressure measurement includes PVDF piezoelectric film sensor, PVDF piezoelectric film sensor set up in lithium ion battery body surface to detect the pressure change on lithium ion battery surface. Through the mode of laminating PVDF piezoelectric film sensor at lithium ion battery shell, but the change of short-term test lithium ion battery external pressure, it is not only convenient but also swift, can effectively prevent the emergence of incident, and PVDF piezoelectric film sensor, its reaction is sensitive, and the preparation is convenient, and use cost is lower.

Lithium ion battery[ technical field ] A method for producing a semiconductor device

The utility model relates to lithium ion battery technical field, in particular to lithium ion battery.

[ background of the invention ]

The electrolyte on the surface of the positive electrode or the negative electrode can be decomposed due to overcharge, overdischarge and the like of the lithium ion battery, a large amount of gas is accumulated, and the battery is locally swelled, leaked and even exploded; or, when the lithium ion battery is subjected to strong collision or extrusion of external force, the battery structure is deformed or even short-circuited, and further the battery is ignited and exploded, so that serious accidents are caused. The pressure changes increase the risk of the lithium ion battery in the using process and seriously affect the safety of users, so how to realize the rapid and accurate detection of the pressure change condition of the lithium ion in the using process becomes a problem which needs to be solved urgently.

[ Utility model ] content

For overcoming the problem that exists among the prior art, the utility model provides a lithium ion battery.

The utility model provides a technical problem's scheme provides a lithium ion battery, its characterized in that: the lithium ion battery comprises a lithium ion battery body and a pressure detection device, wherein the pressure detection device comprises a PVDF piezoelectric film sensor, and the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor is arranged on the surface of the lithium ion battery body so as to detect the pressure change on the surface of the lithium ion battery.

Preferably, the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor includes a lower electrode, a PVDF film, and an upper electrode, and the lower electrode, the PVDF film, and the upper electrode are connected in sequence.

Preferably, the length of the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor is 15mm-120 mm; the width of the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor is 15mm-60 mm.

Preferably, the thickness d1 of the lower electrode is 5um-40 um; the thickness d2 of the PVDF film is 8um-35 um; the thickness d3 of the lower electrode can be 15um-45 um.

Preferably, the bottom electrode comprises a polyimide film, the polyimide film is arranged on the surface of the lithium ion battery body, and the thickness of the polyimide film is 1um-5 um.

Preferably, the surface of the lithium ion battery body comprises an end face and an outer peripheral face, and the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor covers the outer peripheral face of the lithium ion battery body; the ratio of the area of the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor to the area of the outer peripheral surface of the lithium ion battery body is 1/2-9/10.

Preferably, the pressure detection device is further provided with a micro pressure sensor, and the micro pressure sensor is arranged inside the lithium ion battery body to detect the internal pressure change of the lithium ion battery.

Preferably, the lithium ion battery body comprises a battery cell and a soft package shell, and the battery cell is accommodated in the soft package shell; the battery cell comprises a positive plate, a negative plate and a diaphragm, wherein the diaphragm is arranged between the positive plate and the negative plate.

Preferably, the positive plate comprises a positive substrate, and the positive substrate is any one of aluminum foil, aluminum mesh and graphene; the negative plate comprises a negative substrate, and the negative substrate is any one of copper foil, copper mesh and graphene.

Preferably, the lithium ion battery body further comprises a heat dissipation aluminum plate, and the heat dissipation aluminum plate is arranged on the outer side of the lithium ion battery body.

Compared with the prior art, the utility model discloses a lithium ion battery has following advantage:

1. through the mode of laminating PVDF piezoelectric film sensor at lithium ion battery shell, but the change of short-term test lithium ion battery external pressure, it is not only convenient but also swift, can effectively prevent the emergence of incident, and PVDF piezoelectric film sensor, its reaction is sensitive, and the preparation is convenient, and use cost is lower.

The length and the width of the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor are set, so that the sensor can be used for various lithium ion batteries with different types, and can be only attached to partial areas of the lithium ion batteries, the pressure change of the lithium ion batteries can be detected, the detection effect is good, and the use cost is low.

And 3, the thickness of each layer of the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor is set, so that the pressure change can be detected, and the use of the lithium ion battery cannot be influenced due to too thick thickness.

The area of the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor is set, so that the detectable range of the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor is larger, and the lithium ion battery can be better detected.

5. Through the mode of placing miniature pressure sensor in the lithium ion battery, can detect the change of battery internal pressure fast, both convenient, swift, the cost is also lower.

6. Through set up heat dissipation aluminum plate on lithium ion battery surface, can effectively improve lithium ion battery's radiating efficiency, prevent lithium ion battery because of the high short circuit of temperature, can effectively improve lithium ion battery's life.

The attached drawings indicate the following:

1. a lithium ion battery;

10. a lithium ion battery body; 11. a pressure detection device;

101. an electric core; 102. a soft package housing; 103. an electrolyte; 104. an end face; 105. an outer peripheral surface;

111. a miniature pressure sensor; 112. PVDF piezoelectric film sensor

1011. A positive plate; 1012. a negative plate; 1013. a diaphragm; 1014. a tab; 1015. a film; 1016. a metal strip;

1121. a lower electrode; 1122. a PVDF film; 1123. and an upper electrode.

[ detailed description ] embodiments

In order to make the objects, technical solutions and advantages of the present invention more clearly understood, the present invention is further described in detail below with reference to the accompanying drawings and the embodiments. It should be understood that the specific embodiments described herein are merely illustrative of the invention and are not intended to limit the invention.

Referring to fig. 1, a lithium ion battery 1 provided by the first embodiment of the present invention includes a lithium ion battery body 10 and a pressure detection device 11, wherein the pressure detection device 11 is disposed on the lithium ion battery body 10 to detect the pressure change condition of the lithium ion battery body 10 in the using process in real time, thereby avoiding occurrence of safety accidents.

Referring to fig. 2, the lithium ion battery body 10 includes a battery cell 101, a soft package case 102 and an electrolyte 103, the battery cell 101 and the electrolyte 103 are both contained in the soft package case 102, and the electrolyte 103 is used to ensure normal operation of the battery cell 101, so as to ensure normal charging and discharging of the lithium ion battery body 10. The material adopted by the soft package shell 102 includes, but is not limited to, an aluminum plastic film.

It can be understood that the electrolyte 103 mainly plays a role of conducting ions between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the lithium ion battery body 10, and is a guarantee for the lithium ion battery to obtain the advantages of high voltage, high specific energy and the like.

Referring to fig. 3 in conjunction with fig. 2, the battery cell 101 includes a positive plate 1011, a negative plate 1012, a diaphragm 1013 and a tab 1014, wherein the diaphragm 1013 is disposed between the positive plate 1011 and the negative plate 1012 to ensure that the positive plate 1011 and the negative plate 1012 are not short-circuited due to direct contact, and the tab 1014 is respectively connected to the positive plate 1011 and the negative plate 1012, so that when the battery cell 101 is placed into the soft package housing 102, the tab 1014 can be exposed from one end of the soft package housing 102 to be used as a contact point between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the lithium ion battery body 10 to ensure normal use of the lithium ion battery body 10.

The positive electrode sheet 1011 includes lithium cobaltate, a conductive agent, a PVDF binder (polyvinylidene fluoride), a solvent, a positive electrode substrate, and the like, wherein the lithium cobaltate, the conductive agent, the PVDF binder, and the solvent are mixed with each other to form a lithium cobaltate slurry, and the positive electrode substrate is used for coating the lithium cobaltate slurry.

The material used for the positive electrode substrate includes, but is not limited to, aluminum foil, aluminum mesh, and the like, and the material used for the solvent includes, but is not limited to, N-methyl pyrrolidone.

The lithium cobaltate is an anode active material and is mainly used for providing a lithium ion source for the lithium ion battery; the conductive agent is used for improving the conductivity of the positive plate 1011, compensating the electronic conductivity of the positive active material, improving the liquid absorption amount of the electrolyte 103 of the positive plate 1011, increasing the reaction interface of the positive plate 1011 and reducing polarization; the positive electrode substrate is mainly used for coating lithium cobaltate slurry and collecting the current generated by the battery active substances so as to form larger current for outputting; the PVDF adhesive is mainly used for bonding lithium cobaltate, a conductive agent and an aluminum foil/aluminum mesh together; the solvent was used mainly to dissolve/swell the PVDF binder, and to dilute the lithium cobaltate slurry.

As a modification, lithium cobaltate may be replaced with lithium manganate, lithium nickelate, lithium cobalt nickel manganate, lithium iron phosphate, or the like.

The manufacturing process flow of the positive plate 1011 includes but is not limited to positive electrode batching, positive electrode stirring, positive electrode slurry drawing, rolling, large plate cutting, powder scraping, powder brushing, roller pair cutting, small plate cutting, positive electrode lug connection and gummed paper pasting.

The compounding further comprises the pretreatment and blending of raw materials, wherein the pretreatment of the raw materials is mainly dehydration, namely, the removal of moisture contained in the raw materials.

It is understood that the dewatering process described above may be performed in a manner including, but not limited to, oven drying.

The raw material blending process mainly comprises ball milling of lithium cobaltate and a conductive agent and dissolution of a PVDF binder. The ball milling process is to mix the lithium cobaltate and the conductive agent initially, bond the lithium cobaltate and the conductive agent together to improve the agglomeration and the conductivity, and prevent the lithium cobaltate from being distributed in the PVDF adhesive independently after being prepared into slurry. In the ball milling process, agate balls are also needed to be added as ball milling media in order to avoid mixing impurities.

It will be appreciated that the above-described dewatering may be carried out in a manner including, but not limited to, oven drying

The negative electrode sheet 1012 mainly includes graphite, a conductive agent, an additive, an aqueous binder, and a negative electrode substrate, in which the graphite, the conductive agent, the additive, and the aqueous binder are mixed with each other to form a graphite slurry, and the negative electrode substrate is used to coat the graphite slurry.

Materials used for the negative electrode substrate include, but are not limited to, copper foil, copper mesh, graphene, and the like.

It can be understood that graphite is a negative electrode active material, is a main material constituting a negative electrode reaction, and is mainly classified into two main types, i.e., natural graphite and artificial graphite; the conductive agent is mainly used for improving the conductivity of the negative plate 1012, compensating the electronic conductivity of the negative active material, improving the reaction depth and the utilization rate, preventing dendritic crystals from generating, improving the reaction interface by utilizing the liquid absorption capacity of the conductive material, and reducing polarization (the conductive agent can be added or not added according to the particle size distribution of graphite); the negative electrode substrate is used for coating graphite slurry; the additive is used for reducing irreversible reaction so as to improve adhesion, improve viscosity of graphite slurry and prevent the graphite slurry from precipitating; aqueous binders are used to bind graphite, conductive agents, additives and copper foil or mesh together.

It will be appreciated that the dendrites are collectively referred to as dendrites, and are crystals that develop in the form of a typical multi-dendrite tree.

As a modification, graphite may be replaced with Mesophase Carbon Microbeads (MCMB), Carboxymethyl starch (CMS), or the like.

The manufacturing process flow of the negative plate 1012 comprises negative electrode material preparation, negative electrode stirring, negative electrode slurry drawing, rolling, large plate cutting, powder scraping, powder brushing, double roller cutting, small plate cutting, negative electrode lug connection and gummed paper pasting.

The negative electrode ingredients mainly comprise graphite, so that the raw materials are homogenized, and the consistency is improved; baking graphite at 300-400 ℃ under normal pressure to remove oily substances on the surface of the graphite and improve the compatibility with the water-based adhesive; rounding the edge angle of the graphite surface; and diluting the aqueous binder appropriately to improve its dispersing ability.

The material used for the separator 1013 includes, but is not limited to, a single layer of polypropylene, a single layer of polyethylene, a polypropylene + ceramic coating, a polyethylene + ceramic coating, a polypropylene + polyethylene, a polypropylene + polypropylene, a polypropylene + polyethylene + polypropylene, because these types of materials have high ion permeability, are insulating, and do not react with the electrolyte 103 and the electrodes.

It is understood that the manufacturing process, specific structure and material of the lithium ion battery body 10 are not limited.

Referring to fig. 4 in combination with fig. 2, the tab 1014 includes a film 1015 and a metal band 1016, the film 1015 is attached to the surface of the metal band 1016 and wraps the surface of the metal band 1016 to prevent a short circuit caused by contact between the metal band 1016 and the soft package 102 when the battery cell 101 is packaged in the soft package 102, and the film 1015 can be melted by heating to adhere to the soft package 102 when the soft package 102 is packaged, so as to prevent the electrolyte 103 in the soft package 102 from leaking and prevent the battery cell 101 from being oxidized.

Further, the tabs 1014 are further divided into a positive tab and a negative tab, wherein the material used for the positive tab metal strip 1016 includes, but is not limited to, aluminum, and the material used for the negative tab metal strip 1016 includes, but is not limited to, nickel, copper nickel plating.

Referring to fig. 5 in combination with fig. 2 and fig. 3, the pressure detecting device 11 includes a micro pressure sensor 111 and a PVDF piezoelectric film sensor 112, wherein the micro pressure sensor 111 and the battery cell 101 are jointly accommodated in the soft package housing 102 for detecting the internal pressure change of the lithium ion battery body 10, and the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor 112 is disposed outside the soft package housing 102 for detecting the pressure change on the soft package housing 102 of the lithium ion battery body 10.

It can be understood that the purpose of the internal pressure detection of the lithium ion battery body 10 is mainly to detect whether the electrolyte 103 leaks; the pressure change source on the soft package shell 102 of the lithium ion battery body 10 mainly comprises external impact force, electrolyte decomposition at the surface of the anode or the cathode is caused due to overcharge, overdischarge and the like of the lithium ion battery body 10, a large amount of gas accumulation is generated, and the lithium ion battery body 10 is locally swelled, so that pressure is generated on the soft package shell 102.

Referring to fig. 6, the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor 112 includes a lower electrode 1121, a PVDF film 1122, and an upper electrode 1123 sequentially disposed, wherein the lower electrode 1121 is connected to the surface of the lithium ion battery body 10 for performing surface pressure detection on the lithium ion battery body 10.

In this embodiment, the lower electrode 1121 is fabricated by depositing a Cu metal film on a polyimide film substrate, and the upper electrode 1123 is fabricated by sputtering an Ag metal film on the surface of the PVDF film 1122 away from the side connected to the lower electrode 1121.

The polyimide film is arranged on the surface of the lithium ion battery body, the thickness of the polyimide film is 1um-5um, and preferably, the thickness of the polyimide film is 1um-3 um.

The length L of the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor 112 can be 15-120mm, preferably the length L can be 20-100mm, and the width D of the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor 112 can be 15-60mm, preferably the width D can be 20-45 mm.

The thickness d1 of the lower electrode 1121 is 5um-40um, further, the thickness d1 thereof can also be 8um-25 um; the thickness d2 of the PVDF film 1122 is 8um-35um, preferably, the thickness d2 thereof can also be 10um-20 um; the thickness d3 of the lower electrode 1121 can be 15um-45um, preferably, the thickness d3 thereof can also be 18um-35 um.

Referring to fig. 7 in combination with fig. 6, the surface of the lithium ion battery body 10 includes an end surface 104 and an outer peripheral surface 105, and the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor 112 covers the outer peripheral surface 105 of the lithium ion battery body 10;

the ratio of the area of the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor 112 to the area of the outer peripheral surface 105 of the lithium ion battery body 10 is 1/2-9/10, and preferably, the ratio of the area of the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor 112 to the area of the outer peripheral surface 105 of the lithium ion battery body 10 is 1/2-4/5.

As an optimized implementation manner, the lithium ion battery body 10 further includes a heat dissipation aluminum plate (not shown), and the heat dissipation aluminum plate is disposed outside the lithium ion battery body 10 to improve a heat dissipation effect of the lithium ion battery body 10 and prolong a service life of the lithium ion battery body.

As another preferred embodiment, the lithium ion battery 1 is further provided with a micro speaker (not shown), the micro speaker is disposed on one side of the lithium ion battery body 10, and the micro speaker is connected to the pressure detection device 11, when the pressure detection device 11 detects a pressure change, the micro speaker can send out an alarm sound to remind a user to repair and replace the lithium ion battery in time, so as to prevent safety accidents.

As another preferred embodiment, the lithium ion battery 1 is further provided with a control chip (not shown), the control chip is disposed on one side of the lithium ion battery body 10, and the control chip is connected to the battery cell 101, and when the control chip detects that the discharge voltage of the battery cell 101 is insufficient, the control chip can control the battery cell 101 to stop discharging, so as to prevent the battery cell 101 from being damaged due to over-discharge.

As a modified embodiment, a wireless communication module is connected to the miniature pressure sensor 111, and the miniature pressure sensor 111 transmits the detected pressure data to the pressure data acquisition end through the wireless communication module.

Referring to fig. 8, a method for manufacturing a lithium ion battery according to a second embodiment of the present invention includes the following steps:

step S1, providing a lithium ion battery body;

and step S2, forming a PVDF piezoelectric film sensor on the lithium ion battery body to obtain the lithium ion battery.

Referring to fig. 9, the step S1 further includes the following steps:

step S11, providing a battery cell and a miniature pressure sensor;

step S12, providing a soft package shell;

step S13, placing the battery cell and the miniature pressure sensor into a soft package shell;

and step S14, injecting electrolyte into the soft package shell, and carrying out vacuum packaging to obtain the lithium ion battery body.

Referring to fig. 10, the step S11 further includes the following steps:

step S111, providing a positive plate, a negative plate, a positive connecting lug and a negative connecting lug;

step S112, welding a positive electrode lug on the positive electrode piece, and welding a negative electrode lug on the negative electrode piece;

step S113, providing a diaphragm, and preparing the positive plate, the negative plate and the diaphragm through a lamination method or a winding method to obtain the battery cell.

In step S113, the positive electrode sheet, the negative electrode sheet, and the separator are arranged in a positive electrode sheet-separator-negative electrode sheet-separator manner.

Referring to fig. 11, the step S2 further includes the following steps:

step S21, a PVDF piezoelectric film sensor is directly prepared on the surface of the lithium ion battery body to prepare and obtain the lithium ion battery; or

Referring to fig. 12, step S2 further includes the following steps;

step S221, preparing a PVDF piezoelectric film sensor; and

and step S222, attaching the piezoelectric film sensor to the surface of the lithium ion battery body to prepare and obtain the lithium ion battery.

Step S21 further includes the steps of:

step S211, preparing a PVDF piezoelectric film sensor lower electrode on the surface of the lithium ion battery body;

step S212, forming a PVDF film on one side of the lower electrode, which is far away from the lithium ion battery body; and

and step S213, preparing an upper electrode on the side of the PVDF film far away from the side connected with the lower electrode.

It is understood that the PVDF film is formed on the lower electrode by means including, but not limited to, attaching, coating, etc.

In step S211, a polyimide film is formed on the surface of the lithium ion battery body, and a Cu metal film is deposited on the polyimide film substrate to prepare a lower electrode;

in step S213, an Ag metal film is sputtered on the surface of the PVDF film on the side away from the side connected to the lower electrode to form an upper electrode.

Referring to fig. 13, a method for detecting a pressure of a lithium ion battery according to a third embodiment of the present invention includes: which comprises the following steps:

step Sa, providing a lithium ion battery, wherein the lithium ion battery comprises a lithium ion battery body and a pressure detection device, the pressure detection device comprises a PVDF piezoelectric film sensor and a miniature pressure sensor, the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor is arranged on the surface of the lithium ion battery body, and the miniature pressure sensor is arranged in the lithium ion battery body;

step Sb, detecting the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor to obtain first pressure data;

step Sc, detecting the miniature pressure sensor to obtain second pressure data; and

and Sd, judging whether the lithium ion battery passes pressure detection or not according to the first pressure data and the second pressure data.

It is understood that the first pressure data is a detected voltage signal of the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor, and the second pressure data is a detected pressure value of the micro piezoelectric film sensor.

Referring to fig. 14, the step Sa further includes the following steps:

step Sa1, applying regular pressure on the lithium ion battery;

step Sa2, providing an acquisition card, and acquiring a voltage signal of the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor by using the acquisition card to obtain first pressure data;

referring to fig. 15, after detection, when pressure acts on the lithium ion battery, the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor deforms, and the voltage detected by the acquisition card is 0.008V; when the pressure disappears, the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor recovers in deformation, a voltage signal of about-0.09V is detected, and after the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor completely recovers in deformation, the detected voltage signal is 0. Therefore, the lithium ion battery can be detected by pressure.

Referring to fig. 16, the step Sb further includes the following steps:

step Sb1, connecting the miniature pressure sensor with a collecting card to collect a pressure signal inside the lithium ion battery to obtain second pressure data;

and step Sb2, the lithium ion battery body after the test in step Sb1 is scratched by a tool, and second pressure data of the pressure signal change inside the lithium ion battery collected by the acquisition card is read.

Referring to fig. 17, after the detection, the pressure value acquired by the acquisition card is about 0.49N for the lithium ion battery in step Sb1, and about 0N for the lithium ion battery in step Sb 2. Therefore, the lithium ion battery can be detected by pressure.

Compared with the prior art, the utility model discloses a lithium ion battery has following advantage:

1. through the mode of laminating PVDF piezoelectric film sensor at lithium ion battery shell, but the change of short-term test lithium ion battery external pressure, it is not only convenient but also swift, can effectively prevent the emergence of incident, and PVDF piezoelectric film sensor, its reaction is sensitive, and the preparation is convenient, and use cost is lower.

The length and the width of the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor are set, so that the sensor can be used for various lithium ion batteries with different types, and can be only attached to partial areas of the lithium ion batteries, the pressure change of the lithium ion batteries can be detected, the detection effect is good, and the use cost is low.

And 3, the thickness of each layer of the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor is set, so that the pressure change can be detected, and the use of the lithium ion battery cannot be influenced due to too thick thickness.

The area of the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor is set, so that the detectable range of the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor is larger, and the lithium ion battery can be better detected.

5. Through the mode of placing miniature pressure sensor in the lithium ion battery, can detect the change of battery internal pressure fast, both convenient, swift, the cost is also lower.

6. Through set up heat dissipation aluminum plate on lithium ion battery surface, can effectively improve lithium ion battery's radiating efficiency, prevent lithium ion battery because of the high short circuit of temperature, can effectively improve lithium ion battery's life.

The above description is only a preferred embodiment of the present invention, and should not be taken as limiting the invention, and any modifications, equivalent replacements, and improvements made within the principle of the present invention should be included within the protection scope of the present invention.
